tldr: 台股盤中首度衝破 44,000 點、台灣股市總市值超越印度躍居全球第五大，新台幣連四升收 31.47 元成最強亞幣。
美伊重啟荷莫茲海峽談判推升亞股，但凱投宏觀警告主要央行今年仍難降息，美債 5/30 年利差跌至一年低點，暗示高利率將持續更久。
金管會主委彭金隆喊話擴大本土資管以拚區域金融中心，華南永昌證獲准開辦財管 2.0 跨入私銀，高資產客群競爭再升溫。
財政部規劃 0–18 歲未成年子女免稅額加碼 50%（約 200 萬戶受惠），並放寬出售繼承自建房屋可併計土地持有期間，降低房地合一稅負擔。
AI 基建題材持續發酵：環球晶預告下半年漲價、台廠 PCB 業者砸 2,000 億擴產、美光示警記憶體缺貨將延續至 2026 年後，避險基金科技股多頭部位創歷史新高。

items.title_zh: 台股早盤衝破 44,000 點創新高後翻黑，記憶體與 PCB 股接棒
items.title_en: TAIEX breaks above 44,000 to new record before retreating, memory and PCB names lead
items.summary_zh: 台股 5/26 早盤在台積電與聯電領軍下一度衝上 44,097 點，漲逾 400 點再創新高，隨後台積電走弱、指數震盪翻黑，但記憶體與 PCB 股持續挺進，預估全日成交量達 1.74 兆元，凸顯 AI 主題盤資金過度集中。
items.summary_en: Taiwan's benchmark TAIEX opened sharply higher on 26 May, briefly piercing 44,097 (up more than 400 points) and setting a fresh all-time high on the back of TSMC and UMC strength. The index later turned negative as TSMC weakened, but memory and PCB names continued to advance with estimated full-day turnover of NT$1.74 trillion, underscoring how concentrated the AI-driven rally has become.

items.title_zh: 台股總市值超越印度 躍升全球第五大股市
items.title_en: Taiwan overtakes India to become world's fifth-largest stock market
items.summary_zh: 彭博資料顯示，台灣股市總市值已超越印度，躋身全球第五大，主要動能來自「護國神山」台積電的爆炸性漲勢。此排名變化既反映台灣半導體題材的強勢，也凸顯外資近期屢屢示警的指數集中度風險。
items.summary_en: According to Bloomberg, Taiwan's total stock-market capitalization has surpassed India's, propelling the island to the fifth spot globally. The move is driven primarily by the explosive rally in TSMC, whose weighting now dominates TAIEX and ETF inflows worldwide. The ranking change highlights both the strength of Taiwan's semiconductor narrative and the concentration risk increasingly flagged by foreign houses.

items.title_zh: 新台幣連四升收 31.47 元 蟬聯最強亞幣
items.title_en: TWD posts fourth consecutive gain to 31.47, strongest Asian currency
items.summary_zh: 美伊和平協議大致談妥、荷莫茲海峽可望重啟，激勵熱錢回頭。新台幣兌美元 5/25 升值 9.8 分收 31.47 元，創近半月新高，台股單日大漲逾 1,300 點。NDF 拋售壓力下，出口商避險成本再增，但風險偏好同步回升。
items.summary_en: A US-Iran peace framework around the Strait of Hormuz drove fresh hot-money inflows into Taipei. The TWD rose 9.8 cents against the USD to close at 31.47 on 25 May, a near-half-month high, while TAIEX surged more than 1,300 points. With non-deliverable forwards repricing aggressively, exporters face renewed FX-hedging pressure even as risk appetite improves.

items.title_zh: 金控獲利王富邦金股價暌違 30 年再現 3 位數
items.title_en: Fubon Financial reclaims NT$100 share price for the first time in 30 years
items.summary_zh: 受首季法說會報捷激勵，市場資金移轉至金融族群，富邦金 5/26 早盤站上 100 元，為近 30 年首見。北富銀合併綜效逐步顯現、富邦人壽股市投資績效強勁，加上資本適足率穩健，是本波重要支撐。
items.summary_en: Following an upbeat Q1 earnings call where management highlighted merger synergies from the Taipei Fubon Commercial Bank integration, Fubon FHC shares rallied past NT$100, a level last seen three decades ago. Strong equity-related profits at Fubon Life and a robust capital ratio were cited as the main drivers. The move makes Fubon the second financial holding to cross the symbolic threshold this cycle.

items.title_zh: 永豐金股東會通過歷史新高股利 1.3 元 七席董事原班人馬連任
items.title_en: SinoPac Financial AGM approves record-high NT$1.3 dividend, slate of seven directors re-elected
items.summary_zh: 永豐金控 5/26 召開股東常會，通過配發每股現金股利 1.3 元再寫歷史新高，並完成第九屆董事會改選共七席、維持原陣容，象徵策略與治理的延續，並維持其在金控同業中具競爭力的配息率。
items.summary_en: At its 2026 AGM on 26 May, SinoPac Financial (2890) passed a cash dividend of NT$1.3 per share — its highest ever — and completed re-election of all seven board seats with the existing line-up intact, signalling continuity of strategy and governance. The dividend keeps SinoPac's payout ratio competitive within the Taiwanese FHC peer group amid an AGM season focused on capital returns.

items.title_zh: 環球晶董座徐秀蘭預告下半年矽晶圓漲價
items.title_en: GlobalWafers chair Doris Hsu signals H2 silicon-wafer price hikes
items.summary_zh: 環球晶 5/25 股東會上，董事長徐秀蘭表示今年市況「相對去年好非常多」，並預告下半年將調漲售價，主因成本上漲與折舊攤提增加。AI 伺服器與先進封裝拉抬矽晶圓稼動率回升，台勝科、中美晶等同業可望受惠。
items.summary_en: At GlobalWafers' (6488) AGM on 25 May, chair Doris Hsu said current market conditions are "far better than last year" and pre-announced a price hike for the second half of 2026, citing both cost inflation and higher depreciation from new capacity. Demand from AI servers and advanced packaging is pulling silicon wafer utilization back to pre-downturn levels, with peers TSC (3532) and Sino-American Silicon (5483) seen as likely beneficiaries.

items.title_zh: 訂單滿、產能缺！PCB 業者揪團砸逾 2,000 億搶建產能
items.title_en: Taiwan PCB makers pool NT$200B+ capex to close AI structural capacity gap
items.summary_zh: 面對 AI 伺服器與 800G 交換器需求爆量，但高層數板與 HDI 產能吃緊，欣興、南亞 PCB、金像電等龍頭未來兩年將合計投入逾 2,000 億元擴充國內外產能，台廠 PCB 供應鏈將鎖定 2027 年前的 AI 建置週期商機。
items.summary_en: Faced with overflowing AI-server and 800G-switch orders but tight high-layer-count and HDI capacity, leading PCB houses including Unimicron, Nan Ya PCB and Gold Circuit are jointly committing more than NT$200 billion in capex over the next two years to expand domestic and overseas fabs. The capacity push positions Taiwan PCB suppliers to anchor the AI build-out cycle through 2027.

items.title_zh: 緯穎洪麗寗：AI 絕對不是泡沫 美廠擴產規模再加碼
items.title_en: Wiwynn chair Emily Hong: "AI is absolutely not a bubble," doubling down on US capacity
items.summary_zh: 緯穎 5/25 股東會上，董事長洪麗寗強調 AI 絕對不是泡沫，客戶對美國新廠產能需求「比想像中更好」，未來將進一步擴大美國新產能，承接 AI 基礎建設龐大商機。緯穎為主要雲端伺服器 ODM，深度連動超大型雲商資本支出。
items.summary_en: Wiwynn (6669) chair Emily Hong told shareholders on 25 May that customer demand for the new US plants is "even better than imagined", confirming further capacity expansion in America to meet the massive AI infrastructure build-out. Hong pushed back on bubble narratives, arguing utilization rates and order visibility remain very strong. Wiwynn is a key cloud-server ODM exposed to hyperscaler capex.

items.title_zh: 半導體、資通訊強拉 主計總處：今年經濟成長坐七望八
items.title_en: DGBAS: Semiconductor and ICT strength may push 2026 Taiwan GDP growth toward 7–8%
items.summary_zh: 主計總處最新預估，2026 年台灣 GDP 成長率可望從原先 3% 多大幅上修至「保 7」基本面，若 AI 出口動能延續最高上看 8%。動能高度集中於半導體與資通訊製造，傳統產業表現低迷，總體數據的集中度風險同步浮現。
items.summary_en: Taiwan's Directorate-General of Budget, Accounting and Statistics now sees full-year 2026 GDP growth accelerating from earlier forecasts of mid-3% to a base case of around 7%, with an upside of 8% if AI export momentum continues. The revision is driven almost entirely by semiconductor and ICT-related production, while traditional sectors remain sluggish. The split highlights growing concentration risk in the macro print itself.

items.title_zh: 富邦金法說會：北富銀合併綜效顯現 全年拚當「五兆元」銀行
items.title_en: Fubon FHC Q1 call: Taipei Fubon Bank merger synergies push group toward NT$5 trillion banking franchise
items.summary_zh: 富邦金首季法說會顯示獲利由富邦人壽領軍，管理層強調北富銀合併綜效已實質貢獻交叉銷售、NIM 提升與資本效率。並提出全年衝刺「五兆元」民營商銀規模的目標，對國泰金與中信金形成壓力。
items.summary_en: Fubon Financial reported strong Q1 results led by Fubon Life, with chair-level commentary emphasizing that the Taipei Fubon Bank merger is now visibly contributing through cross-sell, NIM uplift and improved capital efficiency. Management set an explicit aspirational target of becoming Taiwan's first "NT$5 trillion" private commercial bank by combined asset size by year-end. The framing places further pressure on peers Cathay and CTBC.

items.title_zh: 富邦金羅瑋示警 AI 黑天鵝與七月關稅大限
items.title_en: Fubon chief economist Lo Wei warns of AI black-swan risks and July tariff cliff
items.summary_zh: 富邦金首席經濟學家羅瑋在法說會上提醒，AI 多頭同時要盯緊 AI 硬體供應鏈的存貨堆積與七月初的美國關稅大限，這兩者可能成為下行催化因素。基本面需求真實存在，但漲速過快已累積戰術性風險，與賣方近期對部位過度擁擠的提醒一致。
items.summary_en: At Fubon FHC's Q1 call, chief economist Lo Wei cautioned investors to watch inventory pile-ups in the AI hardware supply chain and the looming early-July US tariff deadline as potential downside catalysts. He argued underlying demand is real, but the speed of the rally has created tactical risk. Fubon's view echoes recent sell-side commentary suggesting positioning is now stretched.

items.title_zh: 金管會主委彭金隆：擴大本土資管規模 拚區域金融中心
items.title_en: FSC chair Peng Jin-long: scale up domestic asset management to compete as regional hub
items.summary_zh: 彭金隆表示，台灣若有意爭取成為區域金融中心，必須擴大本土資產管理業者規模。研議方向包括擴大高資產客戶的境內基金可投資範圍、加速產品核准、提供誘因吸引外資資管設立境內主體；與財管 2.0 政策架構同步推進。
items.summary_en: FSC chair Peng Jin-long said Taiwan must enlarge the AUM of its home-grown asset managers if it wants to compete with Singapore and Hong Kong as a regional financial centre. Concrete measures under discussion include broader access to onshore funds for high-net-worth individuals, faster product approvals, and incentives for foreign asset managers to set up onshore master vehicles. The push aligns with the wider WM 2.0 framework.

items.title_zh: 富邦人壽、富邦產險導入 AI 加速保險三大流程
items.title_en: Fubon Life and Fubon Insurance deploy AI across underwriting, claims and onboarding
items.summary_zh: 富邦金旗下富邦人壽與富邦產險協同布局數位保險，運用 AI 與數位身分驗證優化「投保、核保、理賠」三大核心流程，定位為服務體驗升級與成本槓桿，管理層表示作業時程已具體下降。國泰人壽與南山人壽亦同步推進類似專案。
items.summary_en: Fubon FHC's life and P&C subsidiaries announced a coordinated rollout of AI and digital-ID verification to streamline the three core insurance flows: policy issuance, underwriting and claims. The initiative is positioned as both a service-experience upgrade and a cost lever, with management citing measurable reductions in turnaround times. Peers Cathay Life and Nan Shan are running parallel projects.

items.title_zh: 華南永昌證獲准開辦財管 2.0 跨入私銀領域
items.title_en: Hua Nan Yongchang Securities wins WM 2.0 approval, becomes latest house to enter private-banking arena
items.summary_zh: 金管會核准華南永昌證券開辦「財富管理 2.0」業務，與銀行同等資格服務高資產客戶、提供多元境內外商品。財管 2.0 由銀行延伸至券商通路，私銀 AUM 競爭再升溫；華南金集團視此為承接世代財富傳承資金的重要利器。
items.summary_en: The FSC granted Hua Nan Yongchang Securities approval to launch Wealth Management 2.0 services, putting the brokerage on the same footing as banks for serving high-net-worth clients with diversified onshore and offshore product access. The approval extends WM 2.0 beyond the bank channel and tightens competition for private-banking AUM. Hua Nan group sees this as critical to capturing inter-generational wealth-transfer flow.

items.title_zh: 臺銀辦黃金 RWA 代幣化論壇 打造台灣鏈上經濟起點
items.title_en: Bank of Taiwan hosts gold RWA tokenization forum to pioneer real-world-asset tokenization
items.summary_zh: 適逢 127 週年行慶，臺銀邀集近百家金融同業探討貴金屬 RWA 代幣化發展，與會者認為黃金代幣化是 RWA 切入點，但仍需建立監理框架、資產保管機制與法遵制度。公股龍頭臺銀藉此卡位台灣鏈上經濟先機。
items.summary_en: On its 127th anniversary, Bank of Taiwan brought together nearly a hundred financial institutions to debate tokenized gold as the natural entry point for real-world-asset (RWA) tokenization in Taiwan. Participants flagged that meaningful adoption depends on a clear supervisory framework, custodial infrastructure and compliance systems. The discussion places state-owned BoT at the centre of Taiwan's nascent on-chain economy.

items.title_zh: 黃金存摺交易量較前波高峰減五成 資金轉戰股市
items.title_en: Gold-passbook trading volume falls ~50% from peak as money rotates into equities
items.summary_zh: 金價陷入盤整，銀行業透露近期黃金存摺交易量大幅量縮，市場預估較前波高峰減少約五成。銀行直言股市熱度把可動用資金都吸走，凸顯零售資金快速由防禦性資產轉向高度集中的 AI 題材曝險。
items.summary_en: As gold prices grind sideways, Taiwanese banks report gold-passbook trading volume now down around 50% from the prior peak. Bank channels openly attribute the slump to the equity-market euphoria pulling discretionary savings into the TAIEX rally. The shift highlights how quickly retail capital is rotating away from defensive assets toward concentrated AI-themed exposure.

items.title_zh: 1111 調查：上班族 4 成 ETF 基金 380 萬資產才感「安全」
items.title_en: Survey: 37.5% of Taiwanese office workers prefer ETFs/mutual funds; NT$3.8M is the "safe" net-worth threshold
items.summary_zh: 1111 人力銀行調查指出，台股雖頻創新高，固定薪資族投資仍偏保守：37.5% 偏好 ETF 或基金、36.1% 以存款為主、高風險操作不到 1 成；逾 4 成受訪者 2025 年靠股市獲利，但平均需擁有 380 萬元流動資產才感到「安全」，門檻較往年再上修。
items.summary_en: A 1111 Job Bank survey shows that despite record TAIEX highs, salaried workers remain conservative — 37.5% prefer ETFs/mutual funds, 36.1% keep most assets in deposits, and fewer than 10% take high-risk positions. More than 40% made money in equities in 2025, but respondents on average say NT$3.8 million in liquid assets is needed before they feel financially "safe", a figure that has crept upward in recent surveys.

items.title_zh: 未成年子女免稅額擬加碼 50% 約 200 萬戶受惠 兒少 TISA 將訂專法
items.title_en: MoF plans 50% additional minor-child tax exemption, benefiting ~2 million households; child TISA may get its own statute
items.summary_zh: 行政院本周將拍板「0–18 歲全程支持計畫」，財政部規劃提高 0–18 歲未成年子女免稅額 50%，比照 70 歲以上直系親屬。初估約 200 萬戶受惠，最快今年上路、明年 5 月報稅季適用；兒少 TISA 投資帳戶也將研議專法。
items.summary_en: Under the Executive Yuan's "0–18 Full-Stage Support Plan" to be finalized this week, the Ministry of Finance will raise the personal exemption for children aged 0–18 by 50% (mirroring the bonus given for dependent ascendants aged 70+). It would benefit roughly 2 million households, taking effect as early as this year for the May 2026 filing season. A dedicated statute for the proposed child TISA savings account is also being studied.

items.title_zh: 出售繼承自建屋課稅放寬 持有期間可併計被繼承人土地持有期間
items.title_en: MoF eases capital-gains rule for sale of inherited self-built houses to include land-holding period
items.summary_zh: 財政部放寬個人出售繼承、受遺贈自建房屋的房地合一課稅規定：原本僅能併計被繼承人「房屋」持有期間，現放寬可併計「土地」持有期間。因該類案件多為先持有土地再自建或合建分屋，調整後總持有期間拉長，可顯著降低房地合一稅負。
items.summary_en: The Ministry of Finance has relaxed the rules on selling inherited or bequeathed self-built houses. Previously, only the decedent's holding period of the *house* was tacked onto the heir's holding period; the rule now also lets heirs tack on the *land* holding period. Because such cases typically involve owning the land first then building (or joint-construction sharing), the change can materially lengthen the combined holding period and reduce the integrated land-and-house tax rate.

items.title_zh: 報稅季倒數 8 天 190 萬戶搶搭末班車
items.title_en: May tax-filing season: only 8 days left, 1.9 million households still need to file
items.summary_zh: 截至 5/24，114 年度綜所稅申報已達 508 萬件，佔去年總申報件數 698 萬件的 73%，距 6/1 截止仍有約 190 萬戶待申報。北區國稅局強調網路申報與超商繳款仍是最快選項，銀行與卡片發卡機構則祭出大額回饋搶攻末段繳稅錢包。
items.summary_en: As of 24 May, 5.08 million of an expected 6.98 million returns had been filed for the 2025 tax year, leaving roughly 1.9 million households to file before the 1 June deadline. The Taipei National Taxation Bureau highlighted that the online portal and convenience-store payments remain the fastest options. Banks and card issuers are running large rebates to capture the late-filing wallet share.

items.title_zh: 凱投宏觀：縱使中東衝突落幕 多數央行今年仍難降息
items.title_en: Capital Economics: even if Middle-East conflict ends, most major central banks unlikely to cut rates in 2026
items.summary_zh: 凱投宏觀指出，即便美伊衝突落幕、油價回歸正常，光憑這點不足以讓 G10 多數央行於 2026 年啟動降息。核心服務通膨僵固、薪資黏性與重建中的財政溢酬，使政策利率維持高位；觀點與債市已大致 price out 今年聯準會降息一致。
items.summary_en: A Capital Economics note argues that a resolution of the US-Iran conflict and a normalization of oil prices would not by themselves justify rate cuts in most G10 economies this year. Persistent core services inflation, sticky wage growth and rebuilding fiscal premia are keeping policy rates anchored. The view aligns with bond markets having largely priced out Fed cuts for 2026.

items.title_zh: 賴清德：千億元挺中小微企與傳產 2040 年前協助百萬家智慧化
items.title_en: President Lai pledges NT$100B to upgrade SMEs and traditional industries alongside "AI New Ten Construction" plan
items.summary_zh: 賴清德 5/25 接見工商團體時表示，政府將推動 1,000 億元計畫加速中小微企業及傳統產業升級轉型，搭配「AI 新十大建設」並行，目標 2040 年前協助 100 萬家中小企業導入智慧化技術。
items.summary_en: Receiving business-group representatives on 25 May, President Lai Ching-te reiterated that the government will launch a NT$100 billion programme to accelerate the upgrading and transformation of small, medium and micro enterprises plus traditional industries. The plan will run alongside the broader "AI New Ten Major Construction" initiative, with a target of helping one million SMEs adopt smart-manufacturing technologies by 2040.

items.title_zh: Fed 降息夢碎？美債 5/30 年利差創一年新低 高利率恐更久
items.title_en: Fed rate-cut hopes fade: 5y-30y UST spread hits one-year low signalling "higher for longer"
items.summary_zh: 美國 5 年期與 30 年期公債殖利率利差跌至一年低點，反映長端因財政赤字疑慮上揚，並 price in 「高利率更持久」情境。長端走勢類似「華許時代」：即便市場談論降息，結構性壓力仍使終端利率高檔，股市估值對此 re-pricing 越來越敏感。
items.summary_en: The spread between US 5-year and 30-year Treasury yields has dropped to a one-year low, reflecting rising long-end yields driven by deficit concerns and the market pricing rates staying high longer. The flattening at the long end echoes "Warsh-era" rate dynamics: even amid talk of policy easing, structural pressures keep terminal rates elevated. Equity multiples are increasingly sensitive to this re-pricing.

items.title_zh: 高盛：避險基金科技股多頭部位創歷史新高 AI 樂觀續燒
items.title_en: Goldman: hedge-fund tech longs hit historic high, AI optimism still rising
items.summary_zh: 高盛指出，避險基金上週大舉加碼科技股，買盤為近 3 個月最高，半導體、晶片與 AI 相關企業最受資金追捧。全球避險基金科技股多頭部位刷新歷史紀錄，反映 AI 資本支出若稍有失望，部位風險將非常顯著。
items.summary_en: Goldman Sachs reports that hedge funds aggressively added technology stocks last week, with net buying at a three-month high. Semiconductors, chip-related names and AI plays attracted the largest inflows, and global tech-sector longs across the hedge-fund complex now stand at an all-time record. The data underscores positioning risk if any AI capex disappointment materializes.

items.title_zh: 投行示警：美光 +141%、SK 海力士 +186% 別忘記憶體景氣循環
items.title_en: Investment banks warn: Micron up 141%, SK Hynix up 186% — memory cycle has not been repealed
items.summary_zh: AI 與 HBM 需求帶動記憶體股近兩年漲幅驚人，美光約上漲 141%、SK 海力士上漲 186%。多家賣方提醒，記憶體產業歷史性的循環性並未消失，一旦供給回追或 AI 資本支出放緩，股價回撤幅度可能相當劇烈，為市場提供必要的反向觀點。
items.summary_en: Two-year gains in memory stocks have been spectacular, with Micron up roughly 141% and SK Hynix up 186% on AI / HBM demand. But several sell-side desks now caution that the historical cyclicality of memory has not disappeared; once supply catches up or AI capex slows, share-price drawdowns can be severe. The note is a useful counterweight to the recent unbroken bull narrative.

items.title_zh: 押注美伊和解 韓股開盤狂飆逾 3.4% 突破 8,100 點
items.title_en: Korean stocks surge 3.4% at the open on US-Iran deal bets, breaking above 8,100
items.summary_zh: 韓股 5/26 開盤大漲逾 3.4%，KOSPI 突破 8,100 點，市場押注美伊重啟荷莫茲海峽航運將紓解能源價格壓力並支撐風險資產。三星與 SK 海力士領漲，與台廠晶片股 AI 行情同步；本周稍早韓股表現相對平淡，今日呈現補漲格局。
items.summary_en: South Korean equities rallied sharply on 26 May, with KOSPI opening up more than 3.4% and surpassing 8,100 as investors bet that a US-Iran agreement to reopen the Strait of Hormuz would relieve energy-price pressure and support risk assets. Memory leaders Samsung and SK Hynix led the charge, mirroring AI-driven gains in Taiwanese chip names. The catch-up trade follows a quieter session in Korea earlier in the week.
